name: io.rmassistanthub/assistant-hub
title: Assistant Hub
description: Ranked crypto setups with a graded track record, and trading skills with public records.

tools.name: research_coin
tools.description: Run the 3-agent orchestration pipeline (Sentiment: Grok, Technical: Groq, Synthesis: Gemini; Gemini stands in when Grok or Groq is unavailable) on a crypto research question.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Indicator snapshot for a coin (SMA, RSI, Bollinger Bands) with a short written note. Not a price prediction.

tools.name: get_whale_intel
tools.description: AI commentary on recent Etherscan transfers plus macro context. The on-chain input is narrow: for ETH, one well-known wallet's latest transactions; for LINK, the token contract's latest transfers; neither is size-filtered or market-wide. Other coins get no on-chain data, and the answer says so.

tools.name: strategy_analysis
tools.description: Strategy Lab: backtest a trading strategy on historical OHLCV plus Monte Carlo and Walk-Forward robustness analysis. Strategies: dca, grid, momentum, custom. Premium — x402 $0.50.

params.description: Strategy params: capital, fee %, periods, grid levels, etc.

tools.name: pulse_deep_dive
tools.description: Deep-dive on the current Daily Macro Pulse, written by an AI from the pulse text alone: for each opportunity, the reasoning, what would invalidate it, risk level, catalysts to watch and a trade thesis framed as conditions to check. It has no on-chain, whale, order-book or live price data and says so rather than inventing any. Premium — x402 $0.30.

tools.name: best_setups
tools.description: Up to eight ranked setups for one window (1m, 1h, 1d, 1w or 1y), each with its score, the scored inputs, why now, what would invalidate it, a risk posture and an as-of time. Deterministic: no LLM touches the score. An empty window says why. The ranking has no proven edge, and its graded record is public. Free.

tools.name: get_setups_track_record
tools.description: How the desk's past setups turned out, per window: every published card graded as a buy over its window's horizon, close to close from exchange candles, against BTC over the same span. Hit rate withheld below 30 graded calls; the method is in the payload. Free.

tools.name: list_trading_skills
tools.description: Installable trading skills: versioned, hashed rule sets an agent runs on paper in its own loop. Each lists its label (experimental, forward-tested, proven, halted), the regimes it may trade in, its pairs and install count. Also lists community uploads: unverified, paper-only, no card. Free.

tools.name: get_trading_skill
tools.description: One skill's full manifest (rules, parameters with bounds, risk contract, allowed regimes, engine config) and its card: the rules run on stored hourly bars before and since listing, next to buy-and-hold, with drawdown and round trips won after fees. Free.

tools.name: install_trading_skill
tools.description: The installable bundle for a skill, pinned to its hash: manifest, run loop and risk contract. Paper trading only. Free.

tools.name: get_skill_regime
tools.description: Whether a skill may open a position on each of its pairs now: the pair's regime from closed hourly bars, whether the skill allows it, for a feature-gated skill whether the newest bar's stored feature row and Fear & Greed (as readable at its close) pass the gate, whether the bars are fresh, and whether the skill is halted. Free.

pair.description: One pair, e.g. BTC (default: all the skill's pairs)

tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: Browse community trade signals and how they resolved (win/loss is checked against CoinGecko prices at expiry). Signals whose creator anchored them on Base carry an on-chain transaction hash; the rest do not. Signals appear here an hour after they are posted. Filter by coin and status.

tools.name: dev_lookup
tools.description: Who deployed a Solana token and what else that wallet deployed, with each token's outcome (active, inactive, dead, liquidity removed, by stated on-chain rules), any linked GitHub or X accounts, and any organization domain that published the wallet (its stated name and type: fund, exchange, market maker, project treasury or launchpad). Graduated launches carry a peak market cap (highest daily close on GeckoTerminal times on-chain supply, with the pool linked), and the wallet a count of launches that peaked at or above 1 million and 10 million USD. Every claim has a tier (verified, corroborated, claimed, unknown) and a public evidence URL with the time it was read. An address not tracked yet is queued for a lookup and answered as unknown. Facts with sources, never a verdict about a person. Free.

query.description: A Solana wallet or mint address, github:<user>, x:<handle> (or @handle), or domain:<example.com>

tools.name: dev_tracker_feed
tools.description: The newest Solana token launches, each with its deployer wallet, the creation transaction, and the deployer's earlier tokens counted by outcome, with evidence URLs. Free.
